steps.en: Download the release for your OS, run it, open the local web page
steps.zh: 下载对应系统的发行包，运行后打开本地网页

component.zh: 桌面程序 + 网页界面

steps.en: Pick a provider: pull a local model or paste a cloud API key
steps.zh: 选服务商：拉一个本地模型，或粘贴云端 API key

steps.en: Drop the book or subtitle file, choose the target language, start
steps.zh: 拖入书或字幕文件，选目标语言，开始

steps.en: Swaps formatting tags for placeholders and splits the text into ~450-token chunks
steps.zh: 把排版标签换成占位符，把正文切成约 450 token 的块

steps.en: Sends each chunk with matching glossary terms, checks placeholders, saves it to a checkpoint
steps.zh: 每块带上相关术语发给模型，校验占位符，译完即存断点

steps.en: Rebuilds the original file with the translated text
steps.zh: 把译文装回原文件结构，输出新文件

value.en: A whole book or subtitle file translated in its original layout, without pasting chapters or restarting after a crash
value.zh: 整本书或整份字幕按原格式译好，不用逐章粘贴，崩了也不用从头来

sources: https://github.com/hydropix/TranslateBooksWithLLMs README Quick Start (TranslateBook.exe / ./TranslateBook, http://localhost:5000, ollama pull qwen3:14b)
src/core/epub/tag_preservation.py + placeholder_validator.py (tags replaced by placeholders, validated, mutation correction)
docs/GLOSSARY.md (glossary injected only into chunks where a term appears)
